title.description: Title for the extraction (e.g. 'Book 3 Unit 4 Expressions').

overall_cefr_level.description: The holistic CEFR difficulty rating for the entire set of expressions.

design_audit.description: Thinking Step. Step 1: identify verbatim surface phrase in text. Step 2: formulate canonical base headword with slot placeholders for variable arguments. Step 3: categorize and check uniqueness. Format: 'DRAFT: [Surface Text Excerpt] -> [Canonical Headword with Slots] -> [Category: phrasal verb/collocation/idiom/set phrase] -> [Uniqueness Check]'. Example: 'DRAFT: putting out graphic brochures -> put [something] out -> phrasal verb -> New'.

word.description: The standardized canonical headword entry form. It MUST match the [Canonical Headword with Slots] from design_audit, retaining all bracketed argument placeholders (e.g. 'put [something] out', 'lay siege to [entity]', 'take [something] for granted', 'bring about [something]').

part_of_speech.description: The linguistic classification: 'phrasal verb' (verb + particle/preposition, e.g. 'hinge on', 'factor in', 'tap into'), 'collocation' (habitual multi-word pairing e.g. 'pose a risk to', 'hail [entity] as'), 'idiom' (figurative fixed expression e.g. 'easier said than done'), or 'set phrase' (fixed structural phrase e.g. 'for the time being', 'on a regular basis').

definition.description: A concise, clear definition of the multi-word expression in academic ESL context.

word_cefr_level.description: The specific CEFR difficulty level of this multi-word expression.

quoted_sentence.description: The exact verbatim sentence where the multi-word expression appears in the source text.

example_usage.description: A new, original example sentence demonstrating correct natural usage of the multi-word expression.

expressions.description: List of up to {count} unique phrasal verbs, idioms, collocations, or set phrases found in the text.
